purpose: Single out an exception, an unfortunate occasion, or someone trusted.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
It always seems to rain precisely on days when I have no umbrella.
She, of all people, would never forget a promise.
restrictions: Can mean only on this occasion, especially at a bad moment, or “this person surely would not”.
mistake: Do not assume every に限って expresses a rule or recommendation.
